minutes.headline: Select Board extended the interim town manager 90 days on a 3-2 vote and advanced special town meeting warrant articles.
minutes.summary: The board approved the alcohol license transfer for St Mary and Christ Inc and held the common victualler license until Board of Health approval. It voted to extend the interim town manager despite concern over his second interim job. Most of the meeting reviewed special town meeting warrant articles, mainly salary plan changes for employees, with votes to accept, recommend or defer each.

public_comment.topic: Cemetery Commission has not met since July; called for the chair to resign and criticized its operation, citing a defamation lawsuit.
Criticized board members' comments on Marshall Park funding and the salary plan changes; urged collaborative leadership and respect for employees and volunteers.
A board member urged civility and constructive criticism of elected officials.
Follow-up on cemetery litigation, the town lawyer's role, and alleged wasteful cemetery commission spending; called for removal of commissioners.

what_happened.line: The Select Board extended the interim town manager's contract by 90 days on a 3-2 vote.
The board accepted Article 10, a salary plan change, with the manager's starting step capped at step four, then recommended it 3-1-1.
Article 2, an FY25 school budget amendment, was accepted and recommended unanimously; added Chapter 70 funds go to the school salary reserves line.
The board deferred its recommendation on Article 12 (Marshall Park debt) and on Article 13, a citizens petition, both unanimously.
A legacy budget amendment was added as new article one, then deferred; the warrant goes to the printer after proofing.

why_it_matters: The special town meeting warrant sets what residents will be asked to vote on, including salary plan changes for employees, a school budget amendment, and Marshall Park debt.
Recommendations on Articles 6, 12, 13 and the new legacy article are still open, so the board's position on them is not yet known to voters.
The interim manager arrangement now runs 90 more days, so the town's permanent manager search stays unsettled over that period.
watch_next: The special town meeting vote on the warrant, including Articles 10 and 11 and the deferred Articles 6, 12 and 13.
The board's recommendations on the deferred articles and the new legacy budget amendment article, once the manager updates the dates and the warrant is proofed.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on nearly every vote that both contain, and the main differences are in what each one leaves out. The official minutes record votes that ours lacks (Articles 3, 7, 8, 9 and the Executive Session minutes) and split Article 11 into two motions, while ours has caption errors in the tree-cutting figure and in two member names.
